description:
## Why This Exists

post/injection.rs::prepend_path_header() uses String::from_utf8_lossy() on the existing Path: header value when prepending the hostname. If the path value contains non-UTF-8 bytes (unusual but possible in transit chains), the value is silently corrupted by U+FFFD replacement, potentially breaking the path for downstream transit servers.

## Acceptance Criteria

Use from_utf8 and treat non-UTF-8 path values as absent (insert fresh Path: hostname
 header).
title: injection.rs: prepend_path_header uses from_utf8_lossy on Path header value
